name: Aether Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2013, Aether Industries Limited is a manufacturer of specialty chemicals. The company is sole Indian manufacturer for chemicals such as 4-(2-Methoxyethyl) Phenol (4MEP), and 3-Methoxy-2-Methylbenzoyl Chloride (MMBC), Thiophene-2-Ethanol (T2E), Ortho Tolyl Benzo Nitrile (OTBN), N-Octyl-D-Glucamine, Delta-Valerolactone, and Bifenthrin Alcohol.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Segments FY24[1]
Large Scale Manufacturing (59%) Advanced intermediates and specialty chemicals with application across the industry spectrum. 
Contract Manufacturing (26%)
Manufacture under contractual supply agreements with MNCs. 
CRAMS (14%)
Contract research, scale-up services, technology development, low volume high-value contract manufacturing.

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Stock is trading at 5.12 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 8.42% over last 3 years.
